items.text: Baker Mayfield (thumb) practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday; Todd Bowles will decide Friday between Mayfield and Jalon Daniels. The model projects Daniels and shows a Mayfield scenario.

Tampa Bay WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), RT Luke Goedeke (calf) and LB Christian Rozeboom (finger) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) limited. WR Jalen McMillan is on IR.
Carolina OLBs Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Thomas Incoom (calf) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; Bryce Young (knee) full both days. RB Jonathon Brooks is on IR.
